title: MCP++ ObligationEvent@1
description: Content-addressed obligation lifecycle event for Profile D temporal deontic policy. An allow decision that creates an obligation is incomplete until the obligation is satisfied or compensated. Normative event types: obligation_created, obligation_satisfied, obligation_violated, compensation_required, compensation_completed, compensation_failed. Interface: ObligationEvent@1. Spec: docs/spec/temporal-deontic-policy.md §7–§8.
$comment: Interface label: ObligationEvent@1. Schema marker: mcp++/policy/obligation-event@1. event_cid is minted under mcpp-jcs-v1 over the event body excluding event_cid itself. Deadline passage while status=pending MUST emit obligation_violated; declared compensation then emits compensation_required.

interface.description: Interface label for this event family.

event_type.description: Lifecycle transition that this event records.

event_cid.description: Content id of this event once minted under mcpp-jcs-v1. Optional on the wire before addressing; when set MUST equal the CID of the canonical body excluding event_cid.

obligation_id.description: Stable identifier for the obligation instance across its lifecycle (often derived from decision_cid + clause_id).

decision_cid.description: CID of the PolicyDecision@1 that spawned this obligation.

intent_cid.description: Optional intent CID bound to the originating decision.

policy_cid.description: Optional policy CID bound to the originating decision.

clause_id.description: Policy clause that produced the obligation, when known.

action.description: Obligated act (for example audit/log or human_approval).

deadline.description: Absolute deadline for satisfaction. Empty/null means no temporal deadline.

logical_time.description: Logical evaluation / observation time for this event. MUST NOT be wall-clock injected by the emitter; callers supply deterministic logical time.

status.description: Obligation status after applying this event.

parents.description: Causal parent event CIDs for this obligation's prior lifecycle events. Empty for the first (obligation_created) event.

compensation.description: Compensation plan or outcome associated with this transition, when declared or executed.

reason.description: Stable machine- or human-readable reason (e.g. deadline_passed, compensated_action_failed).

reason_code.description: Optional closed reason token for automation (deadline_passed, satisfied, compensation_failed, …).

receipt_cid.description: Optional receipt or evidence CID that discharges satisfaction or compensation.

trigger.description: Optional obligation trigger from the policy clause (after_execution, before_execution, …).

canonicalization.description: Canonicalization algorithm used to mint event_cid.

metadata.description: Optional non-authoritative metadata copied from the policy clause (human_approval flags, labels).

sequence.description: Optional monotonic sequence number within one obligation_id stream.

eventType.description: Closed set of obligation lifecycle event types (MCPP-047).

obligationStatus.description: Closed set of obligation instance statuses after an event.

cid.description: IPFS CID. CIDv1 base32 (b…) preferred for new mints; CIDv0 (Qm…) remains readable when historical.

iso8601.description: ISO-8601 calendar date/time (optional fractional seconds, Z or ±offset).

action.description: Compensating act that must run when the primary obligation is violated.

on.description: Trigger condition. Default and only normative value is obligation_violated.

evidence_cid.description: Optional evidence CID for completed compensation.
